description: Land Acquisition - Akuramboda, Pallepola D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels (Lot A and Lot B) for a public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of the land locations, boundaries, extents, and survey information. While a government minister is named, the primary focus is on land acquisition matters, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
